16:
Model: free forever + a 7-day welcome trial + Pro.

- Free: Mom persona, water tracking and 1 medicine/supplement reminder, forever. Nobody should lose the reminder for their most important pill because they can't pay.
- 7-day welcome trial of everything, no card, starts after onboarding. People need to hear Dad, Nonna or their Bestie nag them before they'll pay for it.
- Pro: Lifetime $29.99 (the anchor), Annual $19.99 with a 7-day store trial, Monthly $1.99. Pro unlocks 12 more voices, custom names and unlimited reminders.

Paywall: it's personal. The persona you tried to unlock asks you to keep them ("Keep Dad around?"). It opens from 6 moments, each passing a RevenueCat placement: locked persona, medication limit, trial end, streak upsell, custom persona, settings.

A live RevenueCat targeting rule routes placements to different offerings: trial_end opens on Annual (it has the store trial, the natural next step), medication_limit opens on the $1.99 Monthly (small step for someone who just needs one more pill reminder), everything else opens on Lifetime. The offering's metadata picks which plan is highlighted, so I can change or A/B test this from the dashboard without an app update.

On Android, rewarded ads are a second stream (see Catvertising). Customer attributes (persona, care mode, streak, bond level) go to RevenueCat for segmenting.

Results so far: 1 paid subscriber in the first days, from a real App Store purchase.
17:
About half of people with long-term conditions don't take their medicines as prescribed, and forgetting is one of the biggest reasons. Reminders don't fail because they're missing. They fail because people ignore alarms.

Nagly makes the reminder sound like someone who loves you, because people listen to their mom.

- One medicine reminder is free forever, plus water tracking. Nobody loses the reminder for their most important pill because they can't pay.
- No account, works offline, and health data never leaves the phone.
- Built for older parents and families: a familiar voice (even renamed to the real person, like "Subbu Amma"), one-tap "Took it" from the lock screen, big simple buttons, and a weekly summary you can share with family.
- Also covers supplements (vitamins, creatine, protein), so younger, healthy people build the habit too.

A friend's first message after installing was that they finally took their creatine every day because of the nagging.
18:
Where to look:
1. Home: tilt your phone. The water in the bottle stays level and sloshes (accelerometer). Every sip adds bubbles, and hitting your goal throws confetti.
2. The persona's mood drives the animation: proud bounce, worried wobble, disappointed sigh. The speech bubble "types" before a new line, and the background changes with the time of day.
3. History is a chat with your nagger, with a mood stripe on each message.
4. Personas: 15 characters in 5 families, each with their own voice. "Make it yours" lets you give one a real name and emoji.
5. The paywall is personal: the persona you tried to unlock pleads for itself.
6. Notifications with action buttons (+250 ml, +500 ml, Took it) so you never have to open the app.
7. First launch: a spotlight tour that walks you through each feature.
19:
Android only (the iPhone app has no ad SDK at all, by choice).

- Rewarded ads only, and only when the user taps "Watch ad". No banners, no interstitials, never interrupting a reminder.
- The ad is the upsell: watch one ad to borrow Dad, Nonna, Bestie or Spouse for 24 hours, or unlock more medicine reminders for 24 hours. People try a paid persona for free, and many then want to keep it.
- Every ad event (loaded, displayed, opened, revenue, failed) is reported to RevenueCat Ads with placement names, so ad revenue sits next to subscription revenue in one dashboard.
- A remote switch in the RevenueCat offering metadata (monetization_mode: payments / ads / both) turns ads on or off without an app update.

Note: the Android app is still in Google Play review, so it may not be public when you judge.
30:
Deployed from the OneSignal dashboard, with the OneSignal Flutter SDK in the app:

3 live Journeys:
- Win-back: if you haven't logged in 2 days, a push in your persona's voice, then a second one, then an in-app "Welcome back" message with a log button.
- Streak celebrations at 3 and 7 days.
- Trial ending: a push, then an in-app "Keep me around?" message that opens the paywall.

Creative parts:
- One template, 15 voices. Each push uses Liquid ({% case tag.persona_id %}) so Mom, Dad, Nonna or your Spouse writes it.
- The push image is your persona's picture, picked per user by Liquid in the image URL.
- Action buttons (+250 ml / +500 ml) log water without opening the app.
- Outcomes are reported back (water logged, goal met, dose taken), so I can see which push actually made someone drink, not just who clicked.
- Only 6 tags, never health data. Timestamps (not text) so "time since last log" segments stay accurate.
- Deep links (home / insights / paywall).

Early result: the first win-back push was delivered to 5 users and got 1 click (20% CTR).
